mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_release_operation_audit (tenant_id, attempt_id, actor_id, trace_id, action_code, stage_code, campaign_id, organization_id, shop_id, resource_id, business_no, version_no, activation_sequence, before_state, after_state, reason_code, chain_audit_id, original_event_id, observed_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{attemptId}, #{actorId}, #{traceId}, #{action}, #{stage}, #{target.campaignId}, #{target.organizationId}, #{target.shopId}, #{target.resourceId}, #{target.businessNo}, #{target.version}, #{target.sequence}, #{before}, #{after}, #{reason}, #{chainId}, #{originalEventId}, #{observedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT event_id FROM mk_release_operation_audit WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND resource_id = #{resourceId} AND stage_code IN ('ACCEPTED', 'CONFIRMED', 'EXPIRED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT 1
